Description: proposal-orchestrator endpoints-and-host stack (filled by ticket R11): the part with an hourly cost. Interface endpoints for bedrock-runtime, sts, secretsmanager, ssm, ssmmessages and ec2messages with private DNS in the one zone (OD4), a Bedrock endpoint policy naming the runtime role and the OD7 resources, and the host (OD9) with no public IP, IMDSv2 required with hop limit 1, an encrypted gp3 root volume deleted on termination and the runtime instance profile.
